# Components reference

ReelForge has 62 components. This page is generated from their schemas (`packages/core/src/components/`); each frame comes from the golden gallery episode (`fixtures/golden/components/episode.yaml`), rendered by the same engine as your videos. Props are strict: an unknown key is an error with a "did you mean" hint.

Every element also takes the common keys `id`, `place`, `size`, `col`, `layer`, `z`, `enter`, `exit`, `states`, `fx` and `sfx` (see the [episode format](episode-format.md)). Keys named `at` and `until` are time expressions; `color`, `accent` and `colors[]` take a theme color name (`lime`, `cyan`, `red`, `amber`, `violet`, `ink`, `dim`) or a CSS color.

| Component                             | Default size | Default enter | Layer   | Purpose                                                                                                                               |

## rating {#rating}

Stars from 0 to max with halves, filling in turn. For illustrative scores only, never as real customer reviews.

![Frame of the price_tag gallery scene](/components/price_tag.png)

| Prop      | Type    | Default   | Required |
| --------- | ------- | --------- | -------- |
| `value`   | number  |           | yes      |
| `max`     | integer | `5`       |          |
| `label`   | string  |           |          |
| `note`    | string  |           |          |
| `numbers` | boolean | `true`    |          |
| `color`   | string  | `"amber"` |          |
| `dur`     | number  | `1`       |          |
| `size`    | number  | `76`      |          |

## vitals {#vitals}

Heart-rate monitor: an ECG trace sweeping across with a live BPM counter (keyframable).

![Frame of the vitals gallery scene](/components/vitals.png)

| Prop        | Type     | Default        | Required |
| ----------- | -------- | -------------- | -------- |
| `bpm`       | number   | `72`           |          |
| `keyframes` | object[] |                |          |
| `label`     | string   | `"HEART RATE"` |          |
| `unit`      | string   | `"BPM"`        |          |
| `threshold` | number   |                |          |
| `window`    | number   | `3`            |          |
| `grid`      | boolean  | `true`         |          |
| `color`     | string   | `"lime"`       |          |
| `danger`    | string   | `"red"`        |          |
